instruction: Mechanical assembly with exploded-view scene (composite). Build a 5-part mechanical assembly (body + lid + 4 hex-head bolts), author two COLLADA scenes for assembled and exploded views, and tag the parts for organisational grouping. All dimensions are in metres; Z+ is up. # Geometry (metres) 1. **Body** - axis-aligned cuboid 1.0 m x 1.0 m x 1.0 m, lower-left corner at the world origin so that: - X in [0, 1], Y in [0, 1], Z in [0, 1]. 2. **Lid** - axis-aligned slab 1.0 m x 1.0 m x 0.1 m sitting on top of the body: - X in [0, 1], Y in [0, 1], Z in [1.0, 1.1]. 3. **Four M8 x 20 hex-head bolts** placed at the 4 corners of the lid top. Each bolt is a real 3D composite mesh (hex prism head + cylindrical shank), not just a cube: - Across-flats of the hex head = 13 mm = 0.013 m (ISO 4014/4017 M8 standard). - Head thickness = 5.3 mm = 0.0053 m. Head sits directly on the lid top surface so the head occupies Z in [1.1, 1.1053]. - Shank nominal diameter = 8 mm = 0.008 m. Shank length = 20 mm = 0.020 m, descending from the under-head plane so the shank occupies Z in [1.080, 1.1]. - Bolt axis is parallel to world Z. The four bolts are centred at (x, y) = (0.05, 0.05), (0.95, 0.05), (0.95, 0.95), (0.05, 0.95) - a 50 mm inset from each lid corner. - Bolt scene nodes are named `bolt_0`, `bolt_1`, `bolt_2`, `bolt_3` in corner order (0=SW, 1=SE, 2=NE, 3=NW). - All 4 bolts MUST share a single ComponentDefinition / geometry definition - one bolt mesh, four translation-only instances. Deliverables 1. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembled.dae` - COLLADA 1.5 file containing the as-built assembly. The scene graph SHOULD contain: - A node named `body` referencing the body geometry. - A node named `lid` referencing the lid geometry. - Four nodes named `bolt_0`..`bolt_3`, each referencing the shared bolt geometry and transformed to its corresponding corner of the lid top. All parts are in their assembled positions (no extra exploded-view translation). 2. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\exploded.dae` - COLLADA 1.5 file with the same scene-graph structure as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembled.dae, but with an additional +Z layer-offset applied per part: - `body`: shifted by 0.0 m (stays at its assembled position). - `lid`: shifted by +0.5 m in Z. - `bolt_0`.. `bolt_3`: each shifted by +1.0 m in Z. The exploded view's overall Z-extent must exceed the assembled Z-extent by at least 0.4 m (parts are visibly separated along Z). 3. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\tags.json` - JSON file mapping part-tag names to lists of scene-node names: ```json { "Structure": ["body", "lid"], "Fasteners": ["bolt_0", "bolt_1", "bolt_2", "bolt_3"] } ``` The `Structure` tag groups the body and lid; the `Fasteners` tag groups the 4 bolts. # Requirements: 1. Both `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembled.dae` and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\exploded.dae` exist and parse as valid COLLADA. 2. Each DAE contains geometry in the scene graph referencing body + lid + bolt meshes. 3. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembled.dae` bounding box is approximately [0, 1] x [0, 1] x [0, ~1.1053] m (within 0.05 m). 4. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\exploded.dae` world-space Z-extent is at least 0.4 m greater than `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembled.dae` Z-extent, confirming parts were moved apart along +Z. 5. Exactly 4 bolt instances are detectable in `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\assembled.dae`: their world-space centroids lie at the 4 inset corner positions (0.05, 0.05), (0.95, 0.05), (0.95, 0.95), (0.05, 0.95) within 0.02 m tolerance. 6. Bolt is a real 3D hex-head cylinder approximation (not a cube): the hex head must show 6-fold rotational symmetry (FFT of max-radius per angle bin yields dominant frequency 6) and the shank vertices must lie within ~0.005 m of the 8 mm shank diameter. 7. `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\tags.json` exists, is valid JSON, and contains exactly the tags `Structure=["body","lid"]` and `Fasteners=["bolt_0","bolt_1","bolt_2","bolt_3"]` (set equality).
source: MasterSketchUp exploded-view via scenes; ISO 4014/4017 M8 hex bolt; COLLADA 1.5 visual_scene + instance_geometry; SU-Ruby Layer / Tag API
